verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements platform, and the evidence documents no automations or workflows of its own that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Webhooks only trigger workflows in external systems. The `atmn` config-as-code flow (preview, push, pull of pricing plans) is an adjacent pricing-configuration feature, not automation versioning. Any git-based versioning or rollback of that config would be a user-side workaround, and no rollback capability is documented.
